notes.title: Steam Alpha Playtest Content Preview
notes.content:
[h3]Vultures,[/h3][p][/p][p]The September Steam Alpha Playtest is just two weeks away![/p][p]This round builds directly on the feedback you shared in July, with improvements across balance, performance, and core systems. At the same time, we’ve prepared new content to showcase the full scope of Black Vultures to first-time players joining the fight.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re giving you a preview of the maps, gear, and features you’ll experience during the upcoming playtest.
[/p][p]Here’s what awaits you on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][h1][b]// WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/h1][p]Your feedback will continue to shape Black Vultures into a more refined experience. Dive into the core content below and let us know your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]1. Game Modes[/b][/h2][h3][b]  A. Cargo Rush (6v6v6 Quick Match)[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/8510e396af4c1ee9789380ad61d87f2d0fb2d7dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Teams fight to secure the Cargo, transport it to their extraction zone, and hold until the drone arrives. Expect high-intensity close-quarters battles alongside wide-open firefights where tactical weapons turn the tide.[/p][p][i]Your play data from this test will help us balance the maps and shape the ultimate Cargo Rush experience.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]  B. Team Deathmatch (Custom Match Only)[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1241be8b730ab6511f5937f04e702db125a4a8e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A 6v6v6 mode available exclusively through Custom Matches. Designed as a warm-up before jumping into Cargo Rush, it’s the perfect way to test weapons, explore the maps, and sharpen your aim without the pressure of objectives or rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]2. Maps[/b][/h2][h3][b]  A. SNAFU[/b] [/h3][p]A war-torn Eastern European village centered around an industrial complex, with surrounding commercial, residential, and industrial zones. Stacked containers and ruined buildings mark the scars of past battles. Use verticality, cover, and flanking routes to control the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/b6316e488218ad50fb2720b9288706d3fb769594.png"][/img] [/p][h3][b]  B. BLACKBURN (New Map)[/b][/h3][p]A covert refinery buried in the southern deserts of Al Kubra, once a hub for oil smuggling and hidden gold. Sealed off after a devastating chemical strike, it now erupts with conflict as Vultures descend to claim the loot. Narrow sightlines and unforgiving desert terrain demand sharp instincts, rapid adaptation, and ruthless use of tactical weapons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/aafda8e912b145ab36eb18ba0fa485570fcf4c8f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]  C. SYSTEMS & FEATURES[/b][/h3][p]● \[Matchmaking] Cargo Rush supports both Quick Match (MMR-based) and Team Match, where you can form a squad with friends.[/p][p]● \[Team Deathmatch] Available only in Custom Matches. No loot or rewards are earned here, but a great mode for practice and firefights.[/p][p]● \[Ranking System] Track your progress with categories including EXP, Rating, Loot, Combat, Assist, Breach, and Search.[/p][p]● \[Starting Gear] Every account begins with an M4A1 fitted with an underbarrel and scope.[/p][p]● \[Rewards]  Complete a Cargo Rush match to earn rewards. Payouts vary depending on victory, defeat, or MVP status.[/p][p]※ Winning teams keep all the loot collected by their members, which can be viewed in Loot Storage.[/p][p]● \[Loot Crates] Open crates to obtain weapons and attachments, with a chance to secure rare items such as the Drone or RSG60.[/p][p]● \[Shop] Sell unwanted weapons to earn currency and purchase the gear you need. A special Playtest Shop will be available, offering access to weapons normally difficult to obtain.[/p][p]● \[Optimization] Choose from preset graphic options to optimize performance for your PC.[/p][p][/p][p][i]※ Additional systems for crafting gear and parts will also be introduced in the future.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]3. OPERATIVES[/b][/h2][p]Choose from three Operatives, each with unique strengths that shape how you fight. Master their traits and deploy them where they’re needed most:[/p][p][/p][p][b]‣ Vodka[/b] - Slow but durable, built to lead the charge with heavy defense and high HP.[/p][p][b]‣ Mirage[/b] - A true all-rounder, adaptable and effective across any mission.[/p][p][b]‣ Toqui[/b] - Fast and highly mobile, excelling at reaching and securing objectives before anyone else.[/p][p][/p][p]Use their abilities wisely and dominate the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/5b23deb29cd2fd8280985684ed49dc3a19e63434.jpg"][/img] [/p][h2][b]4. PRIMARY WEAPONS & ATTACHMENT CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h2][p]Eight core primary weapons are available, each customizable with a wide range of attachments so you can craft a weapon that fits your playstyle. 

Try high-damage assault rifles like the [b]AK-103[/b], the versatile and mobile [b]M4A1[/b], [b]AK-12[/b] A rifle with decent accuracy and excellent recoil control, the relentless firepower of the [b]MK46 MOD1[/b] LMG, or the long-range precision of the AWM sniper, [b]MK17 MOD0[/b] a battle rifle capable of inflicting lethal damage thanks to its high armor-piercing power, [b]PC7A2[/b] a submachine gun that can deliver burst firepower while remaining easy to control due to its manageable recoil.. New to the September playtest is the [b]CZ BREN 3[/b], offering excellent trigger feel and superior controllability. Mix and match sights, barrels, underbarrels, and more to build the gun that works for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1121ff05202923b2fd7e166a7923a30b1cfc4305.png"][/img] [/p][h2][b]5. SPECIAL WEAPONS[/b][/h2][p]Four high-impact tactical systems are available to change the tide of battle:[/p][p][/p][p]● [b]Suicide Drone[/b] - A one-way explosive drone built for devastating strikes against fortified positions.[/p][p]● [b]Recon Drone[/b] - Scout the battlefield from above to reveal enemy positions and inform your team’s decisions.[/p][p]● [b]PSRL-1 Rocket Launcher[/b] - A precision rocket system designed to eliminate high-value targets and break enemy lines.[/p][p]● [b]RSG60 Mortar[/b] - Devastating area denial firepower, ideal for clearing clustered enemies and holding zones.[/p][p][/p][p]Experience modern warfare with these strategic tools and use them to dominate the battlefield.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1ed40c747558231a03c04a82659684956ecc13be.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]6. COMMUNICATION FEATURES[/b][/h2][p]Play smarter and have more fun with friends. The new Friends and Party systems let you squad up and coordinate directly:[/p][p]● Search for players and add them as friends.[/p][p]● Create a party and join matches together as a unit.[/p][p]● Use the recent players list to reconnect and team up with new allies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/56ba19806df0124b7ff1720fb918137282c34e6d.png"][/img]  [/p][h2][b]7.  MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT[/b][/h2][p]To make the playtest more accessible and immersive across regions, in-game language settings are now available. Select your preferred language and enjoy the battlefield with greater ease.[/p][p]Supported Languages: Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese[/p][p][/p][h2][b]8. GLOBAL SERVER STRESS TEST[/b][/h2][p]This September playtest expands to Asia, North America, and South America, bringing Vultures from across the world together to test server stability.[/p][p][i]* Your participation provides vital data that will help us deliver a smoother and more stable launch experience.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]※ Black Vultures is powered by Unreal Engine 5, offering hyper-realistic visuals and immersive combat. Performance may vary depending on your PC and network specifications. Adjust your in-game settings for the best play experience.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]9. STREAMING & CONTENT CREATION[/b][/h2][p]There are no restrictions during this playtest. Record, stream, and share freely with the community. Showcase your best plays, strategies, and moments using the hashtag #BlackVultures.[/p][p][/p][p]The development team is eager to meet you once again on the battlefield. Thank you for joining us![/p][p][/p][p]▸ The Black Vultures Team [/p]

notes.title: September Steam Alpha Playtest Confirmed!
notes.content:

Your feedback from July sparked sweeping improvements to combat, refined balance across systems, and a cleaner, more intuitive interface. The game now feels sharper at every turn.
[/p][p]This round expands to Asia, North America, and South America, giving players across the globe a chance to take part. With three days of scheduled sessions and up to six opportunities to jump in, you’ll experience firsthand the progress made since our first test.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]// PLAYTEST DATES[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/6f76d4c4fdf053ff707bb98cf7efac53be11645f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can join all six sessions across the weekend to maximize playtime during the playtest. Please note, however, that connecting outside your region may affect performance.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]// HOW TO JOIN[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Returning Vultures:[/b] If you joined the July Playtest, you can log in again with the same account. No additional registration is required![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Players:[/b] Visit the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/"]Black Vultures Steam page[/url] and click “Request Access” under the Playtest section. Spaces are limited, so register early to secure your chance.[/p][list][*][p]Once approved, you will receive a Steam notification or email. Install the client and be ready to join during your region’s scheduled core hours.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]// KEY DETAILS[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Major Improvements: [/b]Your feedback from July inspired sweeping improvements to combat responsiveness, system balance, and UI clarity. A full breakdown of these changes will be revealed soon, but you’ll feel the difference from the moment you log in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Community Feedback: [/b]Every match and every survey response left a mark on development. July’s test proved how dedicated and insightful this community is, and we’re excited to hear your voices again as we take the next step together.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Development Build:[/b] This remains an early development build of the game. Some features may still be unstable or limited, and we ask for your help in reporting anything you encounter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content Creation:[/b] Streaming, recording, and sharing your experience is encouraged throughout the test. Whether it’s highlight clips, guides, or full matches, we look forward to seeing the game through your perspective.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]// OFFICIAL COMMUNITY[/b][/h2][p]Join us on Discord to share your experiences, connect with other Vultures, and hear the latest updates directly from the team![/p][list][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]https://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Support: [url="https://blackvultureshelp@wemade.com"]blackvultureshelp@wemade.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]September marks the next step for Black Vultures. With your passion and feedback, the game continues to grow stronger every day. Be part of the second Alpha Playtest and help forge the future of this game together.[/p][p][/p][p]▸ The Black Vultures Team
[/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #06 - Shaping What Comes Next
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/c7e275da19dd250b3ea218b09f4a736838d9b53b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]Apologies for the radio silence. We’ve been carefully reviewing all the feedback from the first Steam Alpha Playtest and mapping out the road ahead. Rather than rushing out an update, we wanted to take the time to absorb everything you shared and respond with clarity and intent.[/p][p]First and foremost, thank you to everyone who joined us during the test! It was an early build with plenty of rough edges, but your presence and passion helped bring Black Vultures to life in a way we’ll never forget.[/p][p]Your responses, both in-game and through the survey, have already helped shape the next phase of development. We’re now preparing for a second playtest currently scheduled for late September, and we’re excited to share a preview of what’s to come![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Map: BLACKBURN[/b][/h3][list][*][p]SNAFU gave us a strong foundation, but we know variety is key. Our next map, BLACKBURN, is set in a desert oil facility and designed for faster, more intuitive engagements. It offers a different tempo and layout that should challenge your tactical thinking in new ways.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also adjusting lighting and visual elements to improve character readability and make map elements easier to interpret during combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Party Up and Play Together[/b][/h3][list][*][p]One of the most common requests during the first test was a party system. We heard you loud and clear.[/p][/*][*][p]In the next test, you’ll be able to add friends and form squads directly in-game. We’re also working on player search, friend list management, invites, and improved communication tools so you can drop in as a team and coordinate your approach from the very start.[/p][/*][*][p]Our long-term goal is to build deeper co-op features that highlight the importance of teamwork in Black Vultures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]More Meaningful Progress and Rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re introducing a ranking system tied to your play data to bring in competitive motivation and long-term goals. At the same time, we’re adjusting our reward structure to ensure players who fall short of extraction still feel like they’ve earned something meaningful.[/p][/*][*][p]We want to make every match feel more rewarding, regardless of how it ends.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Refining Combat and Character Identity[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re keeping the core combat feel you responded well to, but we’re making targeted balance adjustments. This includes tuning sniper performance and improving weapon-swap behavior during fights to make actions feel smoother and more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also adding passive abilities to characters, giving each one a bit more personality and utility. This should allow players to make more strategic choices about which operator fits their style or the current mission.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Performance and Anti-Cheat[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re optimizing graphic presets and improving performance across the board to ensure smoother play, even on lower-end systems. In parallel, we’re strengthening our security features with both EAC and our own internal measures to protect against cheating and ensure a fair environment for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]The first test was an incredibly valuable experience for us. We’re taking what we learned and using it to deliver a more refined, smoother version of Black Vultures for the second test in September.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Making the Game More Accessible[/b][/h3][list][*][p]It became clear during the first test that while many of you understood the core rules, the flow of the mission and the ticket system weren’t always easy to grasp at the start. We’re working on a short tutorial video that will play as you enter the game, giving a quick overview of the Cargo Rush mission and core game structure to lower the entry barrier.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also improving the readability and clarity of UI elements like the loadout and respawn screens to reduce confusion during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]And finally, we’re expanding language support to help players around the world enjoy the game more comfortably.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll have more details to share in the coming weeks, but for now, thank you again for helping us take this first step together![/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: End of the Playtest Announcement
notes.content: [p]Vultures,[/p][p][/p][p]After three intense days, the Black Vultures Steam Alpha Playtest has come to a close, carried by the incredible passion everyone has shown.[/p][p][/p][p]From the excitement of Day 1, to the exploration of new content on Day 2, and the final explosive battles powered by the special supply drop on the last day, every moment was made possible by your presence and dedication. On behalf of the entire development team, we sincerely thank each and every one of you who stood your ground and fought fiercely on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p]We were deeply impressed by the creative strategies, unpredictable plays, and the way you pushed the system to its limits. Every trace and piece of data you left on the battlefield will be an invaluable asset in making Black Vultures a stronger and more engaging game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Final Step, Feedback Survey![/b][/h3][p]The scheduled playtest period may have ended, but the survey event is still ongoing.[/p][p][/p][p]This is your final chance to share your overall impressions, ideas, and anything you felt during the past three days, whether something amazed you or left you wanting more.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback will directly influence the future of Black Vultures, and we sincerely hope you’ll join us in closing out this journey by helping shape the game’s next phase.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]// Survey Event Details[/b] [/h2][list][*][p][b]Survey Period:[/b] From Now until July 30, 2025 (UTC) [/p][/*][*][p][b]Survey Link:[/b] [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScuYePneTmCoVxaKd_O4TfsPOSiXOTno0Nkk_BwulovbdDqEA/viewform?usp=dialog " style="button"]Discord – Steam Alpha Feedback Survey Event[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rewards:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]4 Random Draw Winners: $25 Steam Gift Card [/p][/*][*][p]1 Constructive Feedback Winner: $50 Steam Gift Card [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Winner Announcement:[/b] August 4, 2025 (via Discord) [/p][/*][*][p][b]Official Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our development team is now diving into the data you’ve provided. Analyzing, improving, and pushing forward so we can return stronger and more complete. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your passion and support throughout this playtest. We can’t wait to meet you again in a more advanced, more refined battlefield. [/p][p][/p][p]▸ The Black Vultures Team [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steam Alpha Playtest - Day 2 Complete!
notes.content: [p]Vultures,[/p][p][/p][p]That’s a wrap on Day 2 of the Steam Alpha Playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who jumped back in and brought the battlefield to life once again. Both our dev and ops teams have been watching closely, and your matches, your feedback, and your dedication are making a real difference as we shape the future of Black Vultures together.[/p][p][/p][p]With two days behind us, we’re heading into the final stretch. The last play session begins on July 28, 2025, from 19:00 to 01:00 (UTC-4). We hope to see as many of you as possible for one final push.[/p][p][/p][p]To help you experience even more of what Black Vultures has to offer, we’re dropping a SPECIAL SUPPLY PACKAGE straight into your in-game mailbox before Day 3 begins. notes.title: Steam Alpha Playtest Preload Now Live + Core Content Overview
notes.content:
[p]Vultures,[/p][p]Pre‑download for the Black Vultures Steam Alpha Playtest has officially begun! If you were accepted into the playtest, head to your Steam Library now and install the Playtest client to be among the first to enter the battlefield when the test begins on July 25.[/p][p]As we count down to launch, here’s a detailed look at what you’ll experience during the playtest:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]//PRELOAD NOW AVAILABLE[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]How to Install[/b]: Open the Steam client → Go to Library → Search for “Black Vultures Playtest” → Click \[Install] If you don’t see the game in your Library, try restarting Steam.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Estimated Install Size[/b]: 35 GB[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/7733ccbe63b96244e4d311c584d460ceb172adea.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]// PLAYTEST CONTENT PREVIEW[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Core Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cargo Rush[/b] (6v6v6, Quick Match)[/p][p]A 3-team battle for control of the Cargo. Secure the target, transport it to your team’s extraction zone, and defend it until the retrieval drone arrives.[/p][p]Cargo Rush unfolds inside and outside the Abandoned Hangar on the SNAFU map. You’ll face intense close-quarters gunfights in the central structure, while flanking routes and wide-open spaces allow for heavy weapons and tactical maneuvers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Team Deathmatch[/b] (Custom‑Match Only)[/p][p]A 6v6v6 free-for-all designed for fast-paced firefights and warm-ups before tackling Cargo Rush. Accessible only through Custom Matches, this mode lets you explore the map and test out different weapons without progression rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map - SNAFU[/b] (Killzone)[/p][p]Set in a devastated Eastern European village, the SNAFU map is divided into three main combat zones: a central industrial hangar, a commercial district, and nearby residential ruins. Massive shipping containers, multi-level buildings, and destructible cover all contribute to a layered, tactical battlefield.[/p][p]Use verticality and line-of-sight to your advantage. Every corner could decide the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]* Your feedback and gameplay data will help us refine the map’s balance and deliver the best possible combat experience.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/b6316e488218ad50fb2720b9288706d3fb769594.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Matchmaking and Progression[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Matchmaking[/b] - Cargo Rush uses a Quick Match system based on your matchmaking rating (MMR) to ensure balanced matches between teams.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Team Deathmatch Mode[/b] - This mode is only available in Custom Match rooms and does not reward loot or victory rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Starting Loadout[/b] - Upon account creation, each player will be granted one primary weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot System[/b] - All members of the winning team in Cargo Rush will earn loot after each mission. You can check and manage your collected items via Loot Storage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot Crates[/b]: Crates contain a variety of weapons and parts, and with a bit of luck, you might even score a high-powered item like the Drone or Javelin.[/p][/*][*][p][b]In-Game Shop (Playtest Only)[/b]: Sell unwanted gear to earn currency, then use it to purchase new equipment. A special test-only shop will be open during the playtest, offering access to weapons and items that are normally harder to obtain.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]※ We are also developing new crafting systems and content that will allow you to acquire equipment and parts through various in-game sources. Stay tuned![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Playable Operatives[/b][/h3][p]Choose one of three Operatives based on your role and playstyle. Each brings unique strengths and weaknesses to the field.[/p][list][*][p][b]Vodka[/b]: A tank with high health and armor, built to lead the charge and hold the line.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Mirage[/b]: A well-rounded operative with flexible combat capabilities, ideal for adapting to any mission.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Toqui[/b]: A swift, agile scout who excels at flanking, rapid objective runs, and mobility-based combat.[/p][/*][/list][p]Master your operative’s strengths and deploy them strategically based on the flow of battle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/5b23deb29cd2fd8280985684ed49dc3a19e63434.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Primary Weapons and Custom Attachments[/b][/h3][p]Experiment with seven core firearms, each with distinct characteristics and compatible attachments, including the high-damage AK, the versatile M4A1, the suppressive MK46, and the long-range AWM.[/p][p]Customize weapons to suit your style with a range of attachments like scopes, grips, and suppressors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/3937c0d01b92d48eaf4be536e379bb936fbdff23.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]4. Special Weapons[/b][/h3][p]Deploy some of the most powerful tools in the Black Vultures arsenal. These high-impact weapons can turn the tide of battle in seconds when used at the right moment:[/p][list][*][p][b]Suicide Drone[/b]: Remotely guided and built for precision, this drone delivers explosive results right where it hurts.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Javelin[/b]: A heavy-duty anti-armor launcher designed to punch through vehicles or fortified positions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PSRL-1[/b]: Tactical, reliable, and devastating when fired into enemy lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]RSG60 Mortar[/b]: Ideal for flushing out enemies in tight formations or entrenched zones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recon Drone[/b]: Stealthy and swift, this aerial unit provides crucial battlefield intelligence, revealing enemy movements before they strike.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re holding ground or pushing through enemy lines, these weapons give you the firepower to make an impact.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/0f0974f7260d1fa038aafb325e2ba0fe4b4c260e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]5. Global Server Stress Testing[/b][/h3][p]This playtest is also a critical opportunity for us to assess server performance. Players across North and South America will be logging in from a variety of locations, allowing us to evaluate connection stability, matchmaking responsiveness, and overall network load.[/p][p]Your participation during this test provides essential data that will help us fine-tune server operations and deliver a smoother, more stable experience at full launch. Every match played and every connection made contributes to building a better foundation for the future of Black Vultures.[/p][p][b]
※ Black Vultures is powered by Unreal Engine 5, delivering a visually rich and immersive combat experience. Depending on your PC and network specs, performance may vary. We recommend adjusting your in-game settings for optimal play based on your environment.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]// STREAMING AND CONTENT CREATION GUIDELINES[/h2][p]Feel free to record, stream, and share your Black Vultures experience throughout the playtest. There are no restrictions. We encourage you to showcase your best moments, tactics, and loadouts. Don’t forget to tag your content with: #BlackVultures[/p][p]The battlefield is almost ready. The team is watching with excitement as Black Vultures lands on your hard drives.[/p][p]Preload the game now and prepare to deploy. We'll see you soon, Vultures!  Please join our Discord! [url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p][p][b]▸ The Black Vultures Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #05 - TOQUI: Born from Chaos
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/71a939940bfaede506f484b325d492a8aa699aa4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]Today, we’re introducing one of the most unpredictable operators in Black Vultures: TOQUI.[/p][p]Known for his blistering speed and ruthless efficiency, TOQUI is a combat specialist who believes that mobility is the key to survival. He strips away anything that slows him down, even if it means leaving himself dangerously exposed. In the right hands, TOQUI becomes a blur of violence, striking before the enemy has time to react.[/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at what makes him so lethal.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]TOQUI[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Real Name[/b]: Clayton Lee Brooks (Nickname: Clay)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Age[/b]: Late 30s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Origin[/b]: Southern U.S. (Union of States)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Combat Role and Playstyle[/b][/h3][p]TOQUI prioritizes speed above all else. He forgoes heavy armor and most defensive gear in favor of maximum agility, allowing him to move faster than any other operator. This gives him a major advantage in flanking, repositioning, and striking vulnerable targets before they can respond.[/p][p]His combat style focuses on using tactical mobility to seize key positions and maximize his offensive potential. But the tradeoff is clear. TOQUI’s low durability means that even a single bullet can spell disaster. He demands precision, awareness, and the ability to escape just as quickly as you attack.[/p][p]If you enjoy hit-and-run tactics, exploiting weak points, and outmaneuvering your enemies with raw speed, TOQUI is your ideal pick.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uudpTcEAzZU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Backstory[/b][/h3][p]TOQUI was once a legendary member of the U.S. military’s elite special forces. His career ended in disgrace after he was implicated in a war crimes investigation related to the abuse of prisoners. Though his role was minimal and largely the result of pressure from commanding officers, he was unable to avoid responsibility.[/p][p]He was dishonorably discharged, stripped of all service recognition and benefits.[/p][p]After leaving the military, TOQUI struggled to reintegrate into civilian life. Rejected by society and consumed by shame, he began to spiral. Alcohol took hold, followed by violence. One night, during a drunken argument, he killed his wife and fled to Central America.[/p][p]There, he became a cartel hitman and slipped further into addiction, eventually finding himself on the run once again. He smuggled himself into Europe and eventually arrived in Antiviyane, where the war had opened new opportunities for mercenaries. It was there that he joined the Vultures, a newly independent force that welcomed anyone with the skills to survive, no questions asked.[/p][p]For the first time in years, TOQUI felt like he had found a place he could belong. But years of substance abuse and trauma had left deep scars. He suffered from severe mental instability and frequent psychological regressions. His moral compass had fractured, and he often clung to his squadmates like a frightened child, unsure of what was real.[/p][p]Yet when the battle begins, everything changes. TOQUI becomes something else entirely. His instincts take over and the fragmented man disappears, replaced by a near-perfect engine of war. His movements are sharp. His decisions are clean. His efficiency is terrifying.[/p][p]In that moment, TOQUI is not broken... he is unstoppable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/b7937fe35fea35c7a0105b53435cf295073c498e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]More operator profiles are on the way. Until then, we hope TOQUI gives you another glimpse into the kind of operators who call the Vultures home.[/p][p]We’ll see you in the field soon, Vultures![/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #04 - The Ghosts of SNAFU
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/e34b6312f4c4423218ee1736ceb1812814624209.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]Today, we’re taking a closer look at the battleground for Cargo Rush. Nestled deep behind the frontlines, this forgotten Eastern European town has become the backdrop for a high-stakes mission that no faction can afford to lose.[/p][p]Let us take you inside SNAFU.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Forgotten Town of Vozneansk[/b][/h3][p]While tracking a missing gold transport unit, a Vultures recon team discovered signs of the lost cargo in Vozneansk, a crumbling outpost left behind in the chaos of war. As the main Vultures prepared to move in, reports came in that two other armed groups were also converging on the city.[/p][p]The Vultures command believes these to be black ops teams from Luthezia and Antiviyane, both likely after the same cargo. With time running out, the Vultures move first, setting the stage for a confrontation that would decide who gets to claim the glory.[/p][p]Though the full operation remains under wraps, our latest gameplay footage offers a glimpse into the desolate streets of Vozneansk and the battles to come.[/p][previewyoutube="HH1As1vTMAw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]The Wounds of War[/b][/h3][p]SNAFU is a map designed with layers of history and tension, reflecting a town caught in the middle of a prolonged war. Its broken structures and deserted streets hold stories of survival, conflict, and loss.[/p][p]At the center stands a towering sniper post, a makeshift structure that commands sightlines across the map. Inspired by a real-world stronghold where a lone marksman changed the tide of battle, this tower symbolizes the battles that once raged here and the ones still to come.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/7322987eaccce897f593d56f62f0d2c39418dc7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Three Distinct Combat Zones[/b][/h3][p]SNAFU is divided into three areas, each offering different tactical opportunities and combat scenarios:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Zone A - Commercial District[/b][/p][list][*][p]Once the bustling heart of the town, this area is filled with small shops, cafés, and a grand hotel. Though battle damage is visible, the layout remains rich with cover and flanking routes. Narrow alleys and broken interiors create the perfect space for ambushes and close-range skirmishes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/4dbVkXhK/ezgif-86a7b538804bf0.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/2d6eb28ca98ee36f08e9dd93325479d7d413756d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zone B - Residential District and Refugee Camp[/b][/p][list][*][p]The quiet remnants of daily life still linger here. Shattered furniture and old toys paint a picture of a life interrupted. Just beyond the homes lies a makeshift refugee camp, a stark reminder of the civilians who once fled for safety. This zone adds emotional weight to the environment and encourages slower, more methodical movement.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/nzK5ytLM/ezgif-51e5a787e759ca.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/5819bdd12d659e5b14bcb488e0be7222bf9c2f06.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zone C - Industrial District[/b][/p][list][*][p]A dense factory zone that once powered the town’s economy. Tall stacks of containers and scattered materials create a dynamic space for vertical and horizontal play. Be sure to make full use of elevation and cover to control this area.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/CMrpCkz2/ezgif-840b1289b38ea6.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/abab10e5ac199b2aecbc7029b26350bc38a68d64.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]SNAFU tells its story through silence, scars, and the battles yet to unfold. A place where scorched buildings, rusted barricades, and narrow paths offer countless ways to outmaneuver your enemy.[/p][p]We’re looking forward to seeing how you fight, adapt, and make your mark inside its walls.[/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #03 - One Cargo, Three Factions, No Mercy
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/505ee35819aca699eec980587be70da103d7b9f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]It’s time to introduce the core game mode that will define your early operations in Black Vultures. In this dev update, we’re pulling back the curtain on Cargo Rush, a 3-faction showdown built around risk, timing, and precision.[/p][p]If you’ve been wondering what kind of missions you’ll be dropping into during the Steam Alpha Playtest, this is where it all begins.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mission Overview[/b][/h3][p]In Cargo Rush, three factions of six players each enter the battlefield with one goal: secure and extract the Cargo before anyone else.[/p][p]Here’s the basic mission flow:[/p][list][*][p]Secure the Cargo when it spawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Transport it to your faction’s Extraction Point (EP).[/p][/*][*][p]Install the Cargo to initiate extraction.[/p][/*][*][p]Hold the point until the drone arrives.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/5tLCtWs1/Cargo-Rush-RE-800x450.gif"][/img][/p][p]The clock is ticking. Each match lasts up to 30 minutes, and there are multiple win conditions:[/p][list][*][p]Successfully complete a Cargo extraction.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminate all enemy respawn tickets.[/p][/*][*][p]Or, if the match times out and no one has completed an extraction, everyone loses.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]How Cargo Works[/b][/h3][p]Cargo appears 90 seconds after the match begins, at a preset location on the map. Once it spawns, it becomes visible:[/p][list][*][p]White if unclaimed.[/p][/*][*][p]Blue if held by your faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashes in enemy colors every 15 seconds if held by the opposing side.[/p][/*][/list][p]Once your team picks it up, you’ll need to deliver it to your EP and start the extraction sequence. The extraction process takes 120 seconds, divided into three phases (30 seconds, 30 seconds, and 60 seconds). If you’re interrupted, progress is saved up to the last completed phase. When you restart the process, you’ll resume from where you left off.[/p][p]Opposing factions can attempt to halt your extraction by interacting with the Cargo for 3 seconds. Only one player can interrupt at a time, and they can’t be interrupted by anything other than death.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/d2aca4b00fc987c4338369a4d0837444b674a123.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Carrier Role[/b][/h3][p]Whoever holds the Cargo becomes the Carrier.[/p][list][*][p]Carriers move slower than usual.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies within 20 meters of the Carrier are auto-marked for 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]This intel is shared in real-time with all teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]The scan refreshes every 5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Choosing who becomes your team’s Carrier and how you protect them becomes a strategic decision. Moving the Cargo is only half the battle… keeping it in possession is the real challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Respawn System: Life Tickets[/b][/h3][p]Each faction starts with a pool of respawn tickets. Every time you die, one ticket is consumed.[/p][list][*][p]All players get one Personal Ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]Each faction starts with five Team Tickets per player (30 total per faction).[/p][/*][*][p]Every 500 points earned by your faction grants an extra Team Ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]If Team Tickets are depleted, players use their Personal Ticket instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Individual players earn a new Personal Ticket every 500 points, up to five max.[/p][/*][/list][p]Run out of both, and you’re stuck spectating from the sidelines.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Forward Respawns[/b][/h3][p]If the Cargo gets close enough to an Extraction Point, the faction furthest from it unlocks a temporary Outpost spawn point to help them re-engage.[/p][p]This system helps maintain pacing and keeps teams from being left behind. It also reduces overlap in approach paths and gives defenders something more to worry about.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/bc668b7137904aa1018966df242a42c0e56d994a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]ATV Respawn System[/b][/h3][p]Need to get back to the fight fast? That’s where ATVs come in.[/p][p]On the respawn screen, players have the option to spawn directly into an ATV. When selected, you’ll appear just outside your faction’s base, near one of three entry routes into the combat zone.[/p][p]Each faction has three ATVs located in their spawn area. These vehicles act as personal transport, perfect for cutting down travel time and launching a quick flank or deep push toward the objective. If an ATV is destroyed or abandoned, it will automatically respawn at the original base location after about 30 seconds.[/p][p]The ATV system gives players the mobility needed to stay in the action, close the distance, or catch the enemy off guard. Use them wisely. Drive with purpose.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Victory and Defeat[/b][/h3][p]Here’s how each match can end:[/p][list][*][p]One faction successfully extracts the Cargo. They win, others lose.[/p][/*][*][p]All respawn tickets are depleted for two factions. The last faction standing wins.[/p][/*][*][p]Match ends with no completed extraction and remaining tickets. All factions lose.[/p][/*][*][p]Extraction is in progress at timeout. If successful, that faction wins. If not, all factions lose.[/p][/*][/list][p]This system ensures that every match pushes toward a conclusion. No one can hide behind a score advantage. You either finish the job or fail trying.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve built Cargo Rush from the ground up to encourage aggressive plays, creative flanks, and clutch team coordination. Expect chaos. Expect tension. And most of all, expect a reason to keep going back in.[/p][p]Next up, we’ll show you where it all takes place: SNAFU.[/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #02 - A New Light on the Battlefield
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/fbb817ddc8da257ee14e84183ffc663e5d897801.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]If you’ve seen our first in-game trailer, you probably noticed something we did too. While it captured the direction we were aiming for, it didn’t fully reflect the visual quality we had in mind.[/p][p]At the time, our team was in the middle of implementing Nanite, a key feature of Unreal Engine. That meant we were also rebuilding many lighting systems and overhauling entire scenes to match. The trailer was made during that transitional phase, and we weren’t able to showcase the full potential of the updated environments.[/p][p]We’ve seen your comments. Some said the game looked dated or older than expected. We understand why, and we’ve taken that to heart. Since then, the Nanite-based environments have stabilized, and our lighting setup has been reworked from the ground up.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/46a9c80170327e7b339ad0c94d8da5e53dc11f4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The image above shows one of our artists fine-tuning a new lighting pass. After seeing the feedback on the original trailer, he took it upon himself to revisit the scene and bring it closer to the visual standard we’re aiming for in the Steam Alpha Playtest.[/p][p]Although, if you look closely, two enthusiastic colleagues seem to be keeping a very close eye on his progress. Some might say this was purely voluntary. Others might say it was… strongly encouraged.[/p][p]Either way, we’ve taken that feedback seriously. Check out the updated gameplay trailer below, now featuring the improved lighting pass in action.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="N-mmvT6rycg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re pushing hard to raise the bar, and the Steam Alpha Playtest is only the beginning. There’s still a lot we want to refine before launch, and your feedback will play a big part in shaping what comes next.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you soon on the battlefield.[/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #01 - Meet the Developers
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/899c79c6286e6f08d117f2ce1098461775855e33.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]We’re the team behind Black Vultures: Prey of Greed, and we’re thrilled to finally introduce ourselves to our Steam community. It’s our first step in building a direct line of communication with you, and we’ve been looking forward to this moment for a long time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q1. Who are we?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]THISMEANSWAR is a studio built by developers who live and breathe FPS games. Many of us have worked together before, developing high-quality titles with Unreal Engine and operating live game services across the globe. That shared experience and deep passion brought us together again, this time to create something new. We didn’t want to chase trends. We wanted to push the genre forward and bring a more complete, layered combat experience to players who are ready for it.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Q2. Why did we decide to make Black Vultures?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’ve always felt that the traditional two-faction structure in most shooters tends to flatten the experience. It often boils down to brute force, and the room for mind games and tactical shifts is limited. So we started asking ourselves a different set of questions. What if players had to constantly weigh risk, timing, and motive? What if survival meant knowing when to retreat just as much as knowing when to fight?[/p][p]That’s the battlefield we set out to create. One where psychological warfare and raw greed intertwine. One where survival, not just marksmanship, determines the victor.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Q3. What did we focus on most during development?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Designing the flow of tension and crafting the layers of psychological warfare were our two biggest priorities.[/p][p]We didn’t want a game where the person with the fastest trigger finger always wins. Black Vultures is built on choices. Do you engage, or do you retreat? Do you risk your lives for the loot, or live to fight another day?[/p][p]The life ticket system is the backbone of that tension. Early in the match, there’s room to explore and experiment. But as tickets dwindle, every skirmish becomes a high-stakes decision. Players who contribute to objectives can bring teammates back into the fight, which opens the door to dramatic reversals.[/p][p]One of our toughest design challenges was handling the complexity that comes with three active factions. Traditional two-team structures are easier to balance. But with three, your team is never fully safe. Someone is always watching. The danger can come from any angle.[/p][p]To solve this, we fine-tuned every map layout and line of sight. From starting paths to high-traffic zones, every inch of the battlefield was designed to encourage unpredictable encounters and organic psychological tension.[/p][p]Lastly, we built the loot system around shared consequences. Team inventories encourage players to think beyond personal stats. Everything you carry matters to everyone, and only the team that makes it out alive gets to claim the prize.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Q4. What are we hoping to learn from the playtest?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]This is our first real opportunity to see how the core systems behave in the hands of actual players. We’re especially focused on feedback in three areas:[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Combat tempo and overall pacing:[/p][list][*][p]Does the loop of looting, fighting, moving, and extracting feel natural?[/p][/*][*][p]Are there any parts that feel too slow or too overwhelming?[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The three-faction dynamic:[/p][list][*][p]Are players experiencing the kind of mind games and tension we envisioned?[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Do unpredictable skirmishes add to the fun, or do they create frustration?[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Balance of the life ticket and loot systems:[/p][list][*][p]Do survival and respawn mechanics encourage smart, team-based decisions?[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Is the risk-reward structure behind loot extraction working as intended?[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][list][*][p]To us, this playtest is the beginning of something we’re building together. Every piece of feedback you give us is a compass, helping us chart the right path forward.[/p][/*][/list][p]Black Vultures: Prey of Greed doesn’t belong to us alone. We’ve embraced a Community-Driven Development mindset from the very beginning. That means this battlefield will be shaped by your hands just as much as ours.[/p][p][/p][p]The Steam Alpha Playtest in July will be the start of that journey. Your feedback will help us sharpen the systems, deepen the tension, and refine the experience into something truly unforgettable.[/p][p]Welcome to the war, Vultures! Let’s write the next chapter together.[/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/63c3f18ca60b67c479d4c4f5466c771d99bc2e95.jpg"][/img][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Black Vultures: July PC Playtest FAQ
notes.content:
[p]Listen up, Vultures.[/p][p][/p][p]The first early playtest for Black Vultures: Prey of Greed is scheduled for late July. Below is everything you need to know about how to join the test and what to expect.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Q1. When is the playtest?[/u][/b][/p][p]A1. The test will take place for five days in late July 2025. The exact dates will be announced soon through our official Discord and social channels.
[/p][p][b][u]Q2. How can I participate?[/u][/b][/p][p]A2. There are three ways to join: Steam Sign-up, Discord and through Social Media events:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Sign-up:[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Click the "Request Access" button on the Steam Store page to be entered into a random selection.[/p][list][*][p][b]Priority Access via Discord:[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Join our official Discord and participate in community events to receive early access keys. Join the Discord here: [/p][p][url="http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame[/url][/p][list][*][p][b]Social Media Events:[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Keep an eye on our official social channels for a chance to win early access keys by participating.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Q3. What content will be available in the playtest?[/u][/b][/p][p]A3. You’ll be able to try out the following modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cargo Rush Mode:[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Our core mode focused on strategic combat between three factions fighting over a single cargo objective.[/p][list][*][p][b]TDM (Team Deathmatch) Mode:[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The beloved Team Deathmatch mode will only be available in custom lobbies and cannot be accessed through Quick Match.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Q4. What are the minimum system requirements?[/u][/b][/p][p]A4. The playtest build requires the following specs:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p]Component[/p][/td][td][p]Specification[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]OS[/p][/td][td][p]Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]CPU[/p][/td][td][p]Intel i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500x[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Memory[/p][/td][td][p]8GB RAM[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]GPU[/p][/td][td][p]RTX 2070 / RX 5700XT[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Storage[/p][/td][td][p]SSD required, 100GB free space.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Target Performance[/p][/td][td][p]1080p, Low Settings, 60 FPS[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b][u]Q5. Where do I submit feedback?[/u][/b][/p][p]A5. When the playtest starts, we’ll open up a #alpha-feedback channel in our official Discord to share your thoughts.[/p][p]All feedback, whether it's bug reports, UX suggestions, or balance discussions, will be reviewed directly by the dev team and will shape the future direction of Black Vultures.[/p][p]Join the Discord here: [/p][p][url="http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Q6. Can I stream or create video content during the test?[/u][/b][/p][p]A6. Yes, you’re welcome to create content. Just be sure to clearly mention that this is an early playtest build. Official logos and media assets will be provided through Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Q7. What regions are eligible to participate?[/u][/b][/p][p]A7. The initial phase of the playtest is focused on select regions. However, we are actively monitoring interest across all territories. If demand is strong in certain areas, we may expand regional access during the playtest. Stay tuned for updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Q8. Where can I find official updates and news?[/u][/b][/p][p]A8. Stay informed through our official channels:[/p][list][*][p]Discord: [url="http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame[/url][/p][/*][*][p]X: [url="https://x.com/bv_community"]https://x.com/bv_community[/url][/p][/*][*][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/@bv_community"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We look forward to your participation and support during our early playtest.[/p][p]Thank you for helping shape the future of Black Vultures: Prey of Greed.[/p][p][/p][p]– The Black Vultures Team [/p]

[h2][b]Welcome to Black Vultures[/b][/h2][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/3bb737808085657378c1c3d3b0ddcb0103785262.jpg"][/img]Vultures, suit up![/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to finally introduce Black Vultures, a tactical first-person shooter born from the chaos of a war that never ended. In this world, honor has no currency. Only risk, survival, and greed remain.[/p][p][/p][p]Three rival factions drop into contested territory. One cargo. No second place. The battlefield is unpredictable, and the clock is always ticking. Outthink the enemy, control the zone, and extract with everything on the line.[/p][p][/p][p]Each squad enters with a limited supply of life tickets, and once they’re gone, you fight with what you have. There’s no backup, no respawns. Just you, your squad, and a shot at making it out alive.[/p][p][/p][p]Victory isn’t just about survival, it’s about walking away with the loot. If your team extracts successfully, the rewards are shared, and every item you bring back is proof of a mission completed and a risk worth taking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1b823f597f1ee94e081392496a934860a6919105.jpg"][/img]We'll soon be kicking off the Alpha Play Test, and your feedback is at the center of what comes next. We believe the best games are made with the people who play them, and our Community-Driven Development (CDD) will ensure your voice is heard.[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know what works, what doesn’t, and what keeps you engaged from one round to the next. Join the conversation and help us shape every fight, every system, and every moment that defines Black Vultures.[/p][p][/p][p]Hit that Steam Wishlist, and meet us on [u][url="http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]Discord[/url][/u] and our official community channels.[/p][p]The battlefield is waiting. Let’s claim it together.
